exposure: Angle of Descent (AoD) measured by intrapartum transperineal ultrasonography
cohort: 70 women admitted to labor at Dr. Mohammad Hoesin Hospital Palembang, Indonesia, with a mean age of 28.29 years and BMI of 30.59 kg/m2.
finding: The optimal Angle of Descent (AoD) for predicting successful vaginal delivery was 94.5 degrees, with a sensitivity of 84.2% and specificity of 45.7%.
mod_finding: The optimal Angle of Descent (AoD) of 94.5 degrees was identified as a predictor for successful vaginal delivery, suggesting its utility in selecting the mode of birth.
cross-section timing: at admission and every 2 hours during labor progression
